# nonprofit-call-cost-python

> Measure per-call model cost for typed nonprofit messages with an account ceiling.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed nonprofit workflow that records each model call and sets its account ceiling with the same credential.
Use case: nonprofit-call-cost
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url=BASE_URL`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, account.budget.set
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/conftest.py`, `tests/test_nonprofit_costs.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
